selection_policy.test_data: evaluate once after finalist selection and repeated-seed training
selection_policy.decision_rule: select non-dominated validation candidates subject to target-hardware feasibility; do not claim global optimality

controlled_training_policy.pretrained_initialization: documented COCO-compatible weights for every architecture
controlled_training_policy.batch_policy: largest stable batch per model with recorded value; use gradient accumulation where supported to keep effective batch comparable
controlled_training_policy.augmentation_policy: one predeclared conservative policy per framework; no test-guided changes
controlled_training_policy.determinism: seed all supported generators and record framework warnings or nondeterministic operations

claim_boundary: best observed trade-off among the six evaluated candidates under the recorded dataset, training, export, and hardware conditions
